title.zh: 卷九十二 列傳第二十二: 蕭奪剌 蕭普達 耶律侯哂 耶律古昱 耶律獨挴 蕭韓家 蕭烏野
title.en: Volume 92 Biographies 22: Xiao Duola, Xiao Puda, Yelu Houshen, Ye Luguyu, Yelu Dumei, Xiao Hanjia, Xiao Wuye
title.raw: 卷九十二 列傳第二十二: 蕭奪剌 蕭普達 耶律侯哂 耶律古昱 耶律獨挴 蕭韓家 蕭烏野 Volume 92 Biographies 22: Xiao Duola, Xiao Puda, Yelu Houshen, Ye Luguyu, Yelu Dumei, Xiao Hanjia, Xiao Wuye

sentences.zh: 蕭奪剌 蕭普達 耶律侯哂 耶律古昱 耶律獨攧 蕭韓家 蕭烏野

translations.literal: Xiao Duola, Xiao Puda, Yelu Houshen, Yelu Guyue, Yelu Dumei, Xiao Hanjia, Xiao Wuye
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Duola, Xiao Puda, Yelu Houshen, Yelu Guyue, Yelu Dumei, Xiao Hanjia, and Xiao Wuye

sentences.zh: 蕭奪剌，字挼懶，遙輦窪可汗宮人。

translations.literal: Xiao Duola, courtesy name Ruanlan, was a palace attendant of the Waqaghan of the Yaolian clan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Duola, whose courtesy name was Ruanlan, had served as a palace attendant to the Waqaghan of the Yaolian clan.

sentences.zh: 祖涅魯古，北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: His grandfather Nielugu was Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Nielugu had been Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 父撒抹，字胡獨堇，重熙初補祗候郎君，累遷北面林牙。

translations.literal: His father Sama, courtesy name Hudujin, at the beginning of the Chongxi era was appointed Attendant Gentleman and was promoted in succession to Northern Privy Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: His father Sama, courtesy name Hudujin, entered service at the start of the Chongxi era as an Attendant Gentleman and rose in time to Northern Privy Secretary.

sentences.zh: 十九年，從耶律宜新、蕭蒲奴伐夏，至蕭惠敗績之地，獲偵候者，知人煙聚落，多國人陷沒而不能還者，盡俘以歸。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he followed Yelu Yixin and Xiao Punu in attacking Xia, reached the place where Xiao Hui had suffered defeat, captured scouts, learned of populated settlements where many countrymen had been lost and could not return, and took them all captive and brought them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he joined Yelu Yixin and Xiao Punu in a campaign against Xia. When they reached the site of Xiao Hui's defeat, they captured enemy scouts and learned where Liao subjects had been trapped in settled districts and could not escape; they took all of them prisoner and brought them home.

sentences.zh: 拜大父敞穩，知山北道邊境事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Senior Grandfather-in-law and put in charge of frontier affairs on the Shanbei Road.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Senior Grandfather-in-law and given charge of frontier affairs along the Shanbei Road.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，歷西南面、西北路招討使，加同中書門下平章事，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning he served in succession as Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest and Northwest, was given the additional title of Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qingning era he served successively as Pacification Commissioner on the southwestern and northwestern frontiers, was promoted to Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 蕭普達，字彈隱。

translations.literal: Xiao Puda, courtesy name Tanyin.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Puda, whose courtesy name was Tanyin.

sentences.zh: 統和初，為南院承旨。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe he served as Southern Chancellery Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Tonghe era he was appointed Southern Chancellery Attendant.

sentences.zh: 開泰六年，出為烏古部節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kaitai he went out as Military Commissioner of the Wugu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Kaitai he was posted as Military Commissioner of the Wugu tribe.

sentences.zh: 七年，敵烈部叛，討平之，徙烏古敵烈部都監。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Dilie tribe rebelled; he suppressed them and was transferred to Commandant of the Wugu-Dilie tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Dilie tribe rebelled; he put down the revolt and was reassigned as Commandant of the combined Wugu-Dilie tribes.

sentences.zh: 遣敵烈騎卒取北阻卜名馬以獻，賜詔褒獎。

translations.literal: He sent Dilie horsemen to obtain famous horses from the Northern Zubu and present them; he was granted an edict of praise and reward.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Dilie cavalry to obtain renowned horses from the Northern Zubu and presented them to the court, for which he received an edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 重熙初，改烏古敵烈部都詳穩，討諸蕃有功。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongxi he was changed to Commandant-Detailed of the Wugu-Dilie tribes and had merit in campaigns against the various frontier peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongxi era he was made Commandant-Detailed of the Wugu-Dilie tribes and earned distinction campaigning against the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 普達深練邊事，能以悅使人。

translations.literal: Puda was deeply versed in frontier affairs and could win people through pleasing them.
translations.idiomatic: Puda knew the borderlands thoroughly and had a gift for winning people over through kindness.

sentences.zh: 有所俘獲，悉散麾下，由是大得眾心。

translations.literal: Whatever he captured he distributed entirely among his subordinates, and thereby won great popular support.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever spoils he took he shared entirely with his men, and in this way he won their deep loyalty.

sentences.zh: 歷西南面招討使。

translations.literal: He served as Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest.

sentences.zh: 党項叛入西夏，普達討之，中流矢，歿於陣。

translations.literal: The Tangut tribes rebelled and fled into Western Xia; Puda campaigned against them, was struck by an arrow in flight, and died on the battlefield.
translations.idiomatic: When Tangut tribes rebelled and fled into Western Xia, Puda led a punitive campaign, was struck by a stray arrow, and fell on the field.

sentences.zh: 帝聞，惜之，賻贈加厚。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it he regretted the loss, and funeral gifts and posthumous rewards were increased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, hearing of his death, mourned the loss and ordered unusually generous funeral gifts and posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 耶律侯哂，字禿寧，北院夷離堇蒲古只之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Houshen, courtesy name Tuting, was a descendant of Puguozhi, Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Houshen, courtesy name Tuting, was descended from Puguozhi, Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 祖查只，北院大王。

translations.literal: His grandfather Chazhi was King of the Northern Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Chazhi had been King of the Northern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 父忽古，黃皮室詳穩。

translations.literal: His father Hugu was Commandant of the Huangpishi.
translations.idiomatic: His father Hugu had served as Commandant of the Huangpishi.

sentences.zh: 侯哂初為西南巡邊官，以廉潔稱，累遷南京統軍使，尋為北院大王。

translations.literal: Houshen first served as southwestern frontier patrol officer and was known for integrity; he was promoted in succession to Commander-in-Chief of Nanjing, and soon after became King of the Northern Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Houshen began as a southwestern frontier patrol officer and won a reputation for integrity. He rose to Commander-in-Chief of Nanjing and soon afterward was appointed King of the Northern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 重熙十一年，党項部人多叛入西夏，侯哂受詔，巡西邊沿河要地，多建城堡以鎮之，徙東京留守。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chongxi many Tangut tribesmen rebelled and fled into Western Xia; Houshen received orders to patrol key points along the river on the western frontier, built many castles to garrison them, and was transferred to Military Governor of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chongxi, as many Tangut tribesmen defected to Western Xia, Houshen was ordered to patrol strategic points along the western rivers, erect numerous fortresses to hold them, and was then transferred to Military Governor of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十三年，與知府蕭歐裏斯討蒲盧毛朵部有功，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he campaigned with Prefect Xiao Oulisi against the Pulumaoduo tribe with merit, and was given the additional title of Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he joined Prefect Xiao Oulisi in a successful campaign against the Pulumaoduo tribe and was given the additional title of Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He retired from office and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office and died.

sentences.zh: 耶律古昱，字磨魯堇，北院林牙突呂不四世孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Guyue, courtesy name Molujin, was the fourth-generation descendant of the Northern Privy Secretary Tulübu.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Guyue, courtesy name Molujin, was a fourth-generation descendant of the Northern Privy Secretary Tulübu.

sentences.zh: 有膂力，工馳射。

translations.literal: He had great physical strength and was skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was powerfully built and excelled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 開泰間，為烏古敵烈部都監。

translations.literal: During the Kaitai era he served as Commandant of the Wugu-Dilie tribes.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaitai era he served as Commandant of the Wugu-Dilie tribes.

sentences.zh: 會部人叛，從樞密使耶律世良討平之，以功詔鎮撫西北部。

translations.literal: When tribesmen of his command rebelled, he followed Commissioner-in-Chief Yelu Shiliang in suppressing them; for his merit he was ordered to pacify and oversee the northwest frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When tribesmen under his authority rebelled, he followed Commissioner-in-Chief Yelu Shiliang in putting down the revolt; for this service he was ordered to pacify and govern the northwest frontier.

sentences.zh: 教以種樹、畜牧，不數年，民多富實。

translations.literal: He taught them tree-planting and livestock raising, and within a few years the people became largely prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: He taught them forestry and animal husbandry, and within a few years the people had grown notably prosperous.

sentences.zh: 中京盜起，命古昱為巡邏使，悉擒之。

translations.literal: When bandits rose at the Central Capital, Guyue was appointed patrol commissioner and captured them all.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits broke out at the Central Capital, Guyue was appointed patrol commissioner and captured every one of them.

sentences.zh: 上親征渤海，將黃皮室軍，有破敵功，累遷御史中丞，尋授開遠軍節度使，徙鎮歸德。

translations.literal: When the emperor personally campaigned against Bohai, he led the Huangpishi army with merit in defeating the enemy; he was promoted in succession to Vice Censor-in-Chief, soon appointed Military Commissioner of Kaiyuan, then transferred to govern Guide.
translations.idiomatic: During the emperor's personal campaign against Bohai he commanded the Huangpishi army with distinction in defeating the enemy. He rose to Vice Censor-in-Chief, was soon made Military Commissioner of Kaiyuan, and was then transferred to govern Guide.

sentences.zh: 重熙二十一年，改天成軍節度使，卒於官，年七十，贈同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi he was transferred to Military Commissioner of Tiancheng, died in office at age seventy, and was posthumously granted Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi he was reassigned as Military Commissioner of Tiancheng, died in office at the age of seventy, and was posthumously granted the title of Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二子：宜新，兀沒。

translations.literal: He had two sons: Yixin and Wumei.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons: Yixin and Wumei.

sentences.zh: 宜新，重熙間從蕭惠討西夏。

translations.literal: Yixin, during the Chongxi era, followed Xiao Hui in campaigning against Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin, during the Chongxi era, followed Xiao Hui in a campaign against Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 惠敗績，宜新一軍獨全，拜北院大王。

translations.literal: When Hui suffered defeat, Yixin's army alone remained intact; he was appointed King of the Northern Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: When Hui's force was routed, Yixin's unit alone came through unscathed, and he was appointed King of the Northern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 兀沒，大康三年為漢人行宮副部署。

translations.literal: Wumei, in the third year of Dakang, served as Deputy Commander of the Chinese Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Wumei, in the third year of Dakang, was appointed Deputy Commander of the Chinese Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙辛誣害太子，詞連兀沒，帝釋之。

translations.literal: When Yelü Yixin falsely accused and harmed the Crown Prince, the case implicated Wumei, but the emperor released him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yelü Yixin falsely accused and destroyed the Crown Prince, the investigation implicated Wumei, but the emperor set him free.

sentences.zh: 是秋，乙辛復奏與蕭楊九私議宮壸事，被害。

translations.literal: That autumn Yelü Yixin again memorialized that Wumei had privately discussed inner-palace affairs with Xiao Yangjiu, and Wumei was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Yelü Yixin again reported that Wumei had privately discussed inner-palace affairs with Xiao Yangjiu, and Wumei was executed.

sentences.zh: 乾統間，贈同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: During the Qiantong era he was posthumously granted Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qiantong era he was posthumously granted the title of Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 蕭韓家，國舅之族。

translations.literal: Xiao Hanjia was of the imperial maternal clan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hanjia belonged to the imperial maternal clan.

sentences.zh: 性端簡謹願，動循禮法。

translations.literal: By nature he was proper, simple, prudent, and earnest, and in all his actions he followed ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was upright, restrained, and conscientious, and in all his conduct he observed ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 清寧中，為護衛太保。

translations.literal: During Qingning he served as Grand Guard Captain.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingning era he served as Grand Guard Captain.

sentences.zh: 大康二年，遷知北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dakang he was promoted to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dakang he was promoted to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 三年，經畫西南邊天池舊塹，立堡砦，正疆界，刻石而還，為漢人行宮都部署。

translations.literal: In the third year he planned the old moat at Tianchi on the southwestern frontier, established fortresses and stockades, rectified the border, inscribed stone markers and returned, and was made Commander of the Chinese Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he surveyed the old moatworks at Tianchi on the southwestern frontier, built fortresses and stockades, fixed the border, set up inscribed boundary stones, and on his return was appointed Commander of the Chinese Palace.

sentences.zh: 是年秋獵，墮馬卒。

translations.literal: That autumn during the imperial hunt he fell from his horse and died.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, during the imperial hunt, he fell from his horse and died.

sentences.zh: 蕭烏野，字草隱，其先出興聖宮分，觀察使塔裏直之孫也。

translations.literal: Xiao Wuye, courtesy name Caoyin, whose ancestors came from the Xingsheng Palace branch, was grandson of surveillance commissioner Talizhi.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Wuye, courtesy name Caoyin, came from the Xingsheng Palace branch of the clan and was a grandson of the surveillance commissioner Talizhi.

sentences.zh: 性孝悌，尚禮法，雅為鄉黨所稱。

translations.literal: By nature filial and respectful to his brothers, he honored ritual propriety and was praised by his neighborhood.
translations.idiomatic: Filial and dutiful toward his brothers, devoted to ritual propriety, he was widely praised in his community.

sentences.zh: 重熙中，補護衛，興宗見其勤恪，遷護衛太保。

translations.literal: During Chongxi he was appointed to the guard corps; Emperor Xingzong saw his diligence and promoted him to Grand Guard Captain.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi era he entered the guard corps; Emperor Xingzong noted his diligence and promoted him to Grand Guard Captain.

sentences.zh: 清寧九年，佐耶律仁先平重元亂，以功加團練使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qingning he assisted Yelu Renxian in suppressing the Zhongyuan rebellion and was given the additional title of Regiment Training Commissioner for his merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Qingning he assisted Yelu Renxian in suppressing the rebellion of Zhongyuan and, for his service, was given the additional title of Regiment Training Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時敵烈部數為鄰部侵擾，民多困弊，命烏野為敵烈部節度使，恤困窮，省徭役，不數月，部人以安。

translations.literal: At that time the Dilie tribe was repeatedly harassed by neighboring tribes and the people were greatly distressed; Wuye was appointed Military Commissioner of the Dilie tribe; he relieved the destitute, reduced corvée, and within a few months the tribesmen were at peace.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Dilie tribe suffered repeated raids from neighboring peoples and its members were in dire straits. Wuye was appointed Military Commissioner of the Dilie tribe; he relieved the poor, lightened corvée burdens, and within a few months the tribe was at peace.

sentences.zh: 尋以母老，歸養於家。

translations.literal: Soon after, because his mother was old, he returned home to support her.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, as his mother had grown old, he resigned and returned home to care for her.

sentences.zh: 母亡，尤極哀毀。

translations.literal: When his mother died he grieved with extreme sorrow and self-mortification.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he mourned her with the deepest grief and self-denial.

sentences.zh: 服闋，歷官興聖、延慶二宮使，卒。

translations.literal: When his mourning ended he served in turn as commissioner of the Xingsheng and Yanqing palaces, and died.
translations.idiomatic: After his mourning period he served in turn as commissioner of the Xingsheng and Yanqing palaces, and died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：烏古敵烈，大部也，奪剌為統軍，克敵有功；

translations.literal: Commentary: The Wugu and Dilie were great tribes; Duola served as commander-in-chief and had merit in defeating the enemy;
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: The Wugu and Dilie were great tribes. Duola served as commander-in-chief and distinguished himself in defeating the enemy;

sentences.zh: 普達居詳穩，悅以使人。

translations.literal: Puda held the post of commandant-detailed and won people through kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Puda held the post of commandant-detailed and won men through kindness.

sentences.zh: 西北，重鎮也，侯哂巡邊以廉稱；

translations.literal: The northwest was a vital region; Houshen patrolled the frontier and was renowned for integrity;
translations.idiomatic: The northwest was a strategic region; Houshen patrolled the frontier and was famed for his integrity;

sentences.zh: 古昱鎮撫而民富；

translations.literal: Guyue pacified the frontier and the people grew wealthy;
translations.idiomatic: Guyue pacified the frontier and made the people prosperous;

sentences.zh: 獨攧駐金肅而夏人不敢東獵。

translations.literal: Dumei was stationed at Jinsu, and the people of Xia did not dare hunt to the east.
translations.idiomatic: Dumei was posted at Jinsu, and the Xia did not dare hunt eastward.

sentences.zh: 噫！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 部人內附，方面以寧，雖朝廷處置得宜，而諸將之力抑亦何可少哉！

translations.literal: When tribal peoples submitted inward, the frontier regions were thereby tranquilized; although the court's arrangements were fitting, how could the strength of the generals be deemed negligible!
translations.idiomatic: When frontier tribes submitted to the dynasty, the borderlands were brought to peace. Though the court's policies were sound, how could the exertions of these generals be thought slight!
